On the right wall, a fire extinguisher hangs inside a glass case. Below it, a potted fern sits on a metal stand. A woman in a pink sweater sits on a bench near the fern. She reads a magazine with bright covers. Next to her, a brown dog on a leash sniffs the floor. The leash is held by a teenager in a hoodie. Above them, a ceiling light fixture glows softly. Near the far end, a receptionist behind a desk types on a keyboard. A stack of files rests on the desk surface. There is no blood visible anywhere in the scene. There is no emergency alarm flashing. There is no window showing the outside world.
